# Lua mod API reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-lua-api.py from scripts/lua_api_table.py and docs/lua_api_notes.md. Do not edit. -->

API level **3**. 109 functions: 41 in both realms, 38 for client mods, 30 for server mods; 26 client events and 12 server events; the game's hooks are in [LUA_HOOKS.md](LUA_HOOKS.md). Start with [MODDING.md](MODDING.md); recipes are in [MOD_COOKBOOK.md](MOD_COOKBOOK.md).

## Tiers

| Tier | How it is turned on | What it allows |
|---|---|---|
| `standard` | on with the mod | events and hooks (read), drawing, HUD panels, touch buttons and binds, sounds and effects, its own settings, storage and pages, reading game settings, the curated console commands, chat and notifications, messages with the server you joined |
| `gamerules` | a switch | server: hook outputs and cancelling, changing players and entities, spawning, votes, map and match control, bots, kicks and bans (only in games you host) |
| `internet` | a switch | HTTPS to the hosts the manifest lists (`http:`), not on the web build |
| `engine_full` | a switch with a warning; never by "grant all"; a mod installed from a link needs a second confirmation | any console command, any cvar that is not private (passwords and keys stay hidden) |

## Both realms

| Function | Tier | Works | Web | Limits | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `xt.on(event, fn)` | standard | yes | yes | - | Calls fn on every `event` (the event tables below). Several handlers per event run in the order added. |
| `xt.command(name, fn [, help [, {fromserver=true}]]) -> full name` | standard | yes | yes | 32 per mod; names a-z 0-9 | Adds the console command `lua_<mod>_<name>` (`sv_lua_<mod>_<name>` for server mods); fn gets the arguments as strings. |
| `xt.cvar(name) -> string\|nil` | standard | yes | yes | - | Reads a cvar. Private cvars and ones named like passwords, keys and tokens read as nil. |
| `xt.setcvar(name, value) -> true` | standard | yes | yes | 64 own cvars per mod; values up to 256 characters without ; " $ \ | Sets one of the mod's own cvars (`lua_<mod>_<name>`, created on first use) or an allowlisted game cvar. |
| `xt.exec(line)` | standard | yes | yes | 8 per call; no ; " $ \ or line breaks | Queues a console command from the realm's list (client: chat, weapon switching, scoreboard, ready, echo...; server: say, echo, and with Game rules restart, kick, match control). |
| `xt.realtime() -> seconds` | standard | yes | yes | - | Seconds since the game started. |
| `xt.save(key, text) -> true` | standard | yes | yes | 64 KB per key, 64 keys | Stores text under key in the mod's own `data/` folder. |
| `xt.load(key) -> text\|nil` | standard | yes | yes | - | Reads what xt.save stored. |
| `xt.setting(name) -> string` | standard | yes | yes | - | The current value of a `setting.<name>` the manifest declares. |
| `xt.after(seconds, fn) -> id` | standard | yes | yes | 256 timers and coroutines per mod | Runs fn once, later. |
| `xt.every(seconds, fn) -> id` | standard | yes | yes | - | Runs fn repeatedly (0: every frame); fn returning false stops it. |
| `xt.cancel(id) -> bool` | standard | yes | yes | - | Stops a timer or coroutine. |
| `xt.spawn(fn) -> id` | standard | yes | yes | - | Runs fn as a coroutine the engine resumes; inside it `xt.sleep` pauses. This is how a mod runs a `while true do ... end` loop. |
| `xt.sleep([seconds])` | standard | yes | yes | - | Inside xt.spawn: pause (0 or nothing: until the next frame). |
| `xt.hook(name, fn)` | standard | with this game's client code | yes | - | Subscribes to one of the game code's mutator hooks (server: LUA_HOOKS.md; client: the CSQC hooks, LUA_HOOKS.md). fn gets one table with the arguments; changing outputs and cancelling need Game rules on the server. |
| `xt.hooknames() -> {names}` | standard | yes | yes | - | Every hook this realm can subscribe to. |
| `xt.json.encode(value) -> string` | standard | yes | yes | depth 32, 256 KB | Tables (arrays and string-keyed), strings, numbers, booleans to JSON. |
| `xt.json.decode(text) -> value \| nil, error` | standard | yes | yes | depth 32, 256 KB of text | JSON to Lua values (null becomes nil). |
| `xt.time.now() -> seconds` | standard | yes | yes | - | Seconds since the game started (as xt.realtime). |
| `xt.time.clock() -> seconds` | standard | yes | yes | - | A high-resolution clock for measuring. |
| `xt.time.unix() -> seconds` | standard | yes | yes | - | Wall-clock time, seconds since 1970 (UTC). |
| `xt.time.date([format [, unixtime]]) -> string` | standard | yes | yes | format up to 64 characters, those directives only | Local date and time; format uses %Y %m %d %H %M %S %a %b %j (default "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"). |
| `xt.game.info() -> table` | standard | yes | yes | - | version, api, apimax, platform ("android", "linux", "windows", "mac", "web"), touch (bool), realm, csqc (client: "godnotic", "foreign" or "none"), offline (client: the offline-only rule is open), caps (table: http, vibrate, clipboard, channel, pages, hooks). |
| `xt.game.has(capability) -> bool` | standard | yes | yes | - | Feature test: "http", "vibrate", "clipboard", "channel", "pages", "hooks", "csqc_hooks", "engine_full", "offline". |
| `xt.locale.lang() -> code` | standard | yes | yes | - | The game's language (`prvm_language`), e.g. "en", "de". |
| `xt.locale.t(key [, ...]) -> string` | standard | yes | yes | locale files up to 64 KB, 512 keys | Looks key up in the mod's `locale/<lang>.txt` (then `locale/en.txt`; lines `key = text`), formats `%s` with the extra arguments, falls back to the key. |
| `xt.data.save(key, value) -> true` | standard | yes | yes | as xt.save | xt.save of a table, as JSON. |
| `xt.data.load(key [, default]) -> value` | standard | yes | yes | - | xt.load and decode; default when missing or unreadable. |
| `xt.vec(x, y, z) -> vector` | standard | yes | yes | - | A vector table {x, y, z} with + - * / unary -, ==, tostring, and :len() :len2() :normalize() :dot(v) :cross(v) :dist(v) :copy(). |
| `xt.forward(angles) -> vector` | standard | yes | yes | - | The unit direction of {pitch, yaw, roll} angles (x/y/z or 1/2/3), as the game uses them. |
| `xt.vectoangles(dir) -> vector` | standard | yes | yes | - | The angles {x=pitch, y=yaw, z=0} that look along dir. |
| `xt.channel(name) -> channel` | standard | yes | yes | name a-z 0-9 _ . up to 32; 1 KB per message; rates in the channel section | A named message channel between a server mod and client mods (see "Messages between server and client mods"). channel:send(...) and channel:on(fn). |
| `xt.settings.page(desc) -> page` | standard | yes | yes | 64 rows, depth 4, strings 256 bytes, 8 pages per mod | Registers a settings page (rows: section, label, switch, slider, choice, text, button, list, image, progress, keybind) shown under Settings > Mods; see "UI descriptions". |
| `xt.menu.page(desc) -> page` | standard | yes | yes | as settings.page | Registers a page of its own in the Mods menu; same rows as settings pages. |
| `xt.page.get(pageid) -> page\|nil` | standard | yes | yes | - | A page this mod registered, to update it (page:set(row, field, value), page:rows(rows), page:remove()). |
| `xt.top() -> {cpu_ms, calls, mem_kb, throttled}` | standard | yes | yes | - | This mod's own cost over the last second (lua_mod_top shows all mods). |
| `xt.http.get(url, fn [, {headers}])` | internet | yes | no | 256 KB response, 15 s, 4 at a time and 30 a minute per mod | HTTPS GET to a host the manifest lists (`http: host, host`); fn(status, body) runs when it is done. Plain http only to localhost. |
| `xt.http.post(url, body, fn [, {type=..., headers}])` | internet | yes | no | body up to 64 KB, as http.get | HTTPS POST, as http.get. |
| `xt.engine.cmd(line)` | engine_full | yes | yes | 16 per call, 1024 characters | Full engine access: runs any console command (queued like typed input). `$` expansion is refused. |
| `xt.engine.cvar(name) -> string\|nil` | engine_full | yes | yes | - | Full engine access: reads any cvar that is not private. |
| `xt.engine.setcvar(name, value) -> bool` | engine_full | yes | yes | - | Full engine access: sets any cvar that is not private or read-only. |

## Client mods

| Function | Tier | Works | Web | Limits | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `xt.screen() -> w, h` | standard | yes | yes | - | The 2D size xt.draw uses. |
| `xt.reserved() -> {{name, x, y, w, h}}` | standard | yes | yes | - | Screen areas the HUD and touch controls use. |
| `xt.freespot(w, h [, side]) -> x, y` | standard | yes | yes | - | A place for a w x h panel clear of them ("left" or "right"). |
| `xt.ingame() -> bool` | standard | yes | yes | - | In a match (connected and signed on). |
| `xt.islocal() -> bool` | standard | yes | yes | - | This game runs the server. |
| `xt.map() -> name` | standard | yes | yes | - | The map, "" outside a match. |
| `xt.time() -> seconds` | standard | yes | yes | - | The match clock. |
| `xt.players() -> {{name, frags, color, slot, me}}` | standard | yes | yes | - | The scoreboard. |
| `xt.me() -> {health, armor, weapon, alive, name, frags, color}` | standard | yes | yes | - | The player's own state. |
| `xt.fingers() -> {{id, x, y}}` | standard | yes | yes | - | Fingers on the screen in 2D coordinates. |
| `xt.mouse() -> x, y` | standard | yes | yes | - | The pointer. |
| `xt.keydown(key) -> bool` | standard | yes | yes | - | A game key is held. |
| `xt.sound(path) -> bool` | standard | yes | yes | 16 a second from all mods, 64 different files | Plays a sound of the game (`sound/...`). |
| `xt.draw.fill(x, y, w, h [, r, g, b, a])` | standard | yes | yes | - | A rectangle (inside "hud"/"draw" handlers and HUD panels). |
| `xt.draw.text(x, y, text [, size [, r, g, b, a]]) -> width` | standard | yes | yes | 1024 characters | Text; ^ colour codes work. |
| `xt.draw.textwidth(text [, size]) -> width` | standard | yes | yes | - | Width of text. |
| `xt.draw.pic(path, x, y, w, h [, r, g, b, a]) -> bool` | standard | yes | yes | 64 different pictures | A picture of the game (`gfx/...`). |
| `xt.draw.clip(x, y, w, h)` | standard | yes | yes | - | Clips later drawing. |
| `xt.draw.noclip()` | standard | yes | yes | - | Ends clipping. |
| `xt.draw.line(x1, y1, x2, y2 [, width [, r, g, b, a]])` | standard | yes | yes | - | A line. |
| `xt.draw.rect(x, y, w, h [, thickness [, r, g, b, a]])` | standard | yes | yes | - | An outlined rectangle. |
| `xt.draw.gradient(x, y, w, h, {r,g,b,a}, {r,g,b,a} [, vertical])` | standard | yes | yes | - | A rectangle shading from the first colour to the second. |
| `xt.draw.circle(x, y, radius [, r, g, b, a [, filled [, segments]]])` | standard | yes | yes | 64 segments | A circle or ring. |
| `xt.draw.textsize(text [, size]) -> w, h` | standard | yes | yes | - | Text metrics: width and line height. |
| `xt.draw.image(file, x, y, w, h [, r, g, b, a]) -> bool` | standard | yes | yes | 1024 x 1024, 32 images per mod, 4 MB of pixels per mod | A PNG or TGA from the mod's own package (`img/logo.png`). |
| `xt.draw.project(v) -> x, y, onscreen` | standard | yes | yes | - | Where a world point appears on the 2D screen this frame. |
| `xt.view() -> {origin, angles, forward, fov_x, fov_y, w, h}` | standard | yes | yes | - | The camera, read only. |
| `xt.hud.panel{id, title, w, h, side, draw=fn} -> panel` | standard | yes | yes | 8 panels per mod | A HUD panel the engine places clear of the touch controls and the stock HUD (xt.freespot), draws inside the "hud" pass, and lets the player move (cvars `lua_<mod>_<id>x/y`, listed in `_lua_hud_panels`). |
| `xt.touch.button{id, label, icon, w, h, side, press=fn, hold=fn, release=fn} -> button` | standard | yes | yes | 8 buttons per mod; 48 px minimum | An on-screen touch button placed like a HUD panel; press/release on the finger, hold every frame while held. icon is an image of the mod's package. |
| `xt.touch.remove(id)` | standard | yes | yes | - | Removes one of the mod's buttons or panels. |
| `xt.bind(key, down [, up])` | standard | yes | yes | 16 keys per mod | Calls down/up when the key (keyboard or gamepad name, e.g. "F5", "JOY3") is pressed in the game, instead of its binding. Keys bound to the console or the menu stay theirs. |
| `xt.unbind(key)` | standard | yes | yes | - | Gives the key back. |
| `xt.effect(name, v [, count])` | standard | yes | yes | 32 a second from all mods | A particle effect of the game (effectinfo name) at a point, seen only by this player. |
| `xt.clipboard(text) -> bool` | standard | yes | no | 4 KB | Puts text on the clipboard; only inside a key, bind or touch button callback (a player's action). |
| `xt.vibrate(ms) -> bool` | standard | yes | yes | 10 to 1000 ms, 2 a second | Vibrates the phone when the platform offers it (game.has("vibrate")). |
| `xt.entities([kind]) -> {{id, kind, x, y, z, team, name, visible}}` | standard | limited online (see doc) | yes | 256 entries | Entities around: kind "player", "projectile", "item" or nil for all. Online, players and projectiles are listed only while they are on screen and not behind a wall (what the player sees); offline against bots everything is listed. |
| `xt.offline() -> bool, why` | standard | yes | yes | - | Whether the offline-only rule is open: this game runs the server, no other human is connected, no demo plays. |
| `xt.csqc() -> "godnotic"\|"foreign"\|"none"` | standard | yes | yes | - | Whose client game code runs: client hooks and the CSQC events need "godnotic". |

## Server mods

| Function | Tier | Works | Web | Limits | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `xt.players() -> {ids}` | standard | yes | yes | - | Player ids (1..maxplayers) of connected clients and bots. |
| `xt.player(id) -> {id, name, bot, frags, spectator, team, health, armor, alive, origin}` | standard | yes | yes | - | A snapshot of one player (xt.ent(id) is the live handle). |
| `xt.tell(id, text)` | standard | yes | yes | 10 a second per player | A chat line to one player. |
| `xt.centerprint(id, text)` | standard | yes | yes | as tell | A centered message to one player. |
| `xt.broadcast(text)` | standard | yes | yes | 5 a second | A chat line to everyone. |
| `xt.map() -> name` | standard | yes | yes | - | The map. |
| `xt.time() -> seconds` | standard | yes | yes | - | The server clock. |
| `xt.maxplayers() -> n` | standard | yes | yes | - | Player slots. |
| `xt.entity(n) -> table\|nil` | standard | yes | yes | - | A snapshot of an entity number (classname, netname, player, owner, health, team, origin). |
| `xt.ent(n) -> handle\|nil` | standard | games you host | yes | - | A live handle to entity n (a player's is their id). Reading `h.<field>` reads any QC field by name; see "Entity handles" for methods. A handle to an entity that was removed (even if its slot is reused) is invalid: h:valid() is false and every other use is an error. |
| `xt.ents.find{class=, field=, value=, near=v, radius=r, limit=} -> {handles}` | standard | games you host | yes | 256 results | Entities by classname, a field's value, and/or distance. |
| `xt.ents.spawn(classname, {origin=v, angles=v, fields...}) -> handle` | gamerules | games you host | yes | 64 live entities per mod, 16 a second | Spawns an item (`item_*`, `weapon_*`), a marker (`target_position`, `info_teleport_destination`, `info_notnull`) or `func_pointparticles` like the map would. Removed when the mod stops. |
| `xt.world.trace(from, to [, ignore]) -> {fraction, endpos, normal, ent, startsolid, allsolid}` | standard | games you host | yes | - | A traceline (players and monsters block it; ignore is a handle or id). |
| `xt.world.contents(v) -> {solid, water, slime, lava, sky}` | standard | games you host | yes | - | What is at a point. |
| `xt.world.sound(v, sample [, volume [, attenuation]]) -> bool` | standard | games you host | yes | 8 a second | Plays a sound of the game at a point for everyone. |
| `xt.world.effect(name, v [, count]) -> bool` | standard | games you host | yes | 16 a second | A particle effect (effectinfo name) at a point for everyone. |
| `xt.world.gametype() -> name` | standard | games you host | yes | - | The game type ("dm", "ctf", ...). |
| `xt.chatcommand(name, fn [, help])` | standard | games you host | yes | 32 per mod; names a-z 0-9 | Players run fn(id, args) by typing `!name args` in chat (the line is not shown) or `cmd name args`. |
| `xt.match.vote(command [, by])` | gamerules | games you host | yes | - | Starts a vote on a stock vote command (`restart`, `gotomap <map>`, `endmatch`, `shuffleteams`, `kick #<id>` ...), as the server or as player `by`. |
| `xt.match.changemap(map)` | gamerules | games you host | yes | - | Goes to a map now. |
| `xt.match.endmatch()` | gamerules | games you host | yes | - | Ends the match. |
| `xt.match.restart()` | gamerules | games you host | yes | - | Restarts the map. |
| `xt.match.setcvar(name, value) -> bool` | gamerules | games you host | yes | - | A gameplay cvar on the server list (g_balance_*, timelimit, fraglimit, g_instagib ...). |
| `xt.bots.add([n [, skill]]) -> n` | gamerules | games you host | yes | up to the free slots | Adds bots (raises bot_number). |
| `xt.bots.remove([n]) -> n` | gamerules | games you host | yes | - | Removes bots (lowers bot_number). |
| `xt.bots.skill([skill]) -> skill` | standard | games you host | yes | - | Reads or (with Game rules) sets bot skill 0-10. |
| `xt.ban.add(id, minutes [, reason])` | gamerules | games you host | yes | - | Kicks and bans a player's address. |
| `xt.ban.remove(index)` | gamerules | games you host | yes | - | Lifts a ban (the number `bans` lists). |
| `xt.page.show(id, desc) -> bool` | standard | games you host | yes | 16 KB, 64 rows, 2 a second per player, replies 20 a second | Shows a page (a UI description, as settings pages) on a player's screen when that player's game allows server pages; buttons and changes come back to the page's callbacks. |
| `xt.page.close(id)` | standard | games you host | yes | - | Closes it. |

## Events: client mods

`xt.on(name, function(...) ... end)`

| Event | Arguments | When | Works |
|---|---|---|---|
| `frame` | dt | every frame, with the seconds since the last one | yes |
| `hud` | w, h | the HUD pass, in a match: draw here | yes |
| `draw` | w, h | every frame, also in menus | yes |
| `key` | key, down, char | a game key; return true to take it | yes |
| `menu` | open | the menu opened or closed | yes |
| `map` | name | a new map ("" when leaving) | yes |
| `unload` | - | the mod is stopping: save here | yes |
| `print` | text | a console line from the server; return false to hide it | yes |
| `chat` | text | a chat line from the server; return false to hide it | yes |
| `centerprint` | text | a centered message from the server; return false to hide it | yes |
| `notification` | kind, name, text, args | a game notification (kind "info", "center", "announce", "multi", "choice"); return false to hide it | with this game's client code |
| `kill` | victim, attacker, name | a kill-feed entry (the notification's name, e.g. DEATH_MURDER_FRAG) | with this game's client code |
| `weapon` | new, old | the player's weapon changed | yes |
| `damage` | amount, health, armor | the player took damage | yes |
| `hit` | amount | the player hit someone (damage dealt) | with this game's client code |
| `pickup` | item | the player picked an item up | with this game's client code |
| `spawn` | - | the player (re)spawned | yes |
| `death` | - | the player died | yes |
| `spectate` | id, old | the spectated player changed (0: none) | yes |
| `match` | state, old | "warmup", "countdown", "playing", "overtime", "ended" | with this game's client code |
| `score` | frags, old | the player's own score changed | yes |
| `hud_overlay` | w, h | inside the game's own HUD pass, over its panels | with this game's client code |
| `scoreboard` | w, h | while the scoreboard shows, over it | with this game's client code |
| `touch` | id, x, y, phase | a finger went down (phase "down"), moved ("move") or up ("up"); the touch controls see it too (put buttons with xt.touch.button where they are not) | yes |
| `connect` | address | joined a server ("local" for a game this game hosts) | yes |
| `disconnect` | - | left it | yes |

## Events: server mods

`xt.on(name, function(...) ... end)`

| Event | Arguments | When | Works |
|---|---|---|---|
| `frame` | dt | every server frame | games you host |
| `map` | name | a new map | games you host |
| `connect` | id | a player connected | games you host |
| `disconnect` | id | a player left | games you host |
| `spawn` | id | a player spawned | games you host |
| `death` | victim, attacker, deathtype | a player died (attacker 0: the world) | games you host |
| `damage` | target, attacker, damage, deathtype | a player takes damage; return a number to replace it (Game rules) | games you host |
| `chat` | id, text, team | a chat line; return false to hold it back | games you host |
| `pickup` | id, item | an item touched; return false to keep it from being picked up | games you host |
| `clientcmd` | id, command, args | `cmd <command>`; return true when handled | games you host |
| `matchend` | - | the match ended | games you host |
| `unload` | - | the mod is stopping | games you host |
